description bullet: 79 of the 80 uncommons in the set are found here. The remaining uncommons are the 9 Nazgûl variants, which show up in a different slot.

description bullet: Each Collector Booster is guaranteed to have 1 of the 10 in traditional foil.

description bullet: Each of the 60 rares (85.7%) and 20 mythic rares (14.3%) from the main set show up in this slot in traditional foil.

Slot: 1 Extended-art rare or mythic rare from main set
description bullet: There are 28 rares (86.1%) and 9 mythic rares (13.9%) from the main set that have been given the extended-art treatment.

Slot: 1 Extended-art rare or mythic rare from Commander decks, Jumpstart Boosters, or Starter Kits
description bullet: There are 81 rares (94.2%) and 10 mythic rares (5.8%) that can be found in this slot. The Jumpstart product has 5 new-to-Magic rares, and each is found in this slot with extended art. Similarly, the Starter Kit has 8 new rares and 2 new mythic rares, which can be found here with extended art. Finally, each of the 68 new rares (excluding the 4 new Sagas) and 8 new mythic rares from the Commander decks can be found here with extended art. All cards found in this slot feature the art of The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth in non-foil.

Slot: 1 Uncommon Nazgûl or an uncommon with the showcase Ring treatment
description bullet: Here, you can get either 1 of 10 uncommons with the showcase Ring treatment (91%) or 1 of 9 possible artworks from the uncommon Nazgûl cards (9%).

Slot: 1 Borderless rare or mythic rare, a rare or mythic rare with the showcase Ring treatment, or a Realms and Relics mythic rare
description bullet:
In this slot, you can find 1 of 14 rares or 6 mythic rares with the showcase Ring treatment (50% in total). This slot may also contain 1 of 5 rare borderless lands or the mythic rare borderless land (18.7% in total) featuring alternate art of the most iconic locations in Middle-earth. You can also open 1 of 30 mythic rare Realms and Relics cards in non-foil (31.3%).
Of note, some borderless cards and cards with the showcase Ring treatment show up in alternate versions as well. For those cards, they will show up half as often as cards of their equivalent rarity in the same treatment.

Slot: 1 Borderless scene card, any rarity
description bullet:
Here, you can get one of the scene cards from each of the seven different possible scenes. Cards found in Prerelease Packs that create Bilbo's Birthday Party scene are foil-stamped traditional foils, and cards from the Bundle and Bundle: Gift Edition that create the Mount Doom scene come in traditional foil. In this slot, each of the borderless scene cards, including cards that create Bilbo's Birthday Party scene and the Mount Doom scene, are non-foil.
There are 9 commons (37.5%), 14 uncommons (29.2%), 21 rares (27.3%), and 9 mythic rares (6%) that can be found in this slot. Like the previous slot, there are also some borderless scene rares and mythic rares that appear in alternate Booster Fun treatments. For those cards, they will show up in this slot half as often as cards of their equivalent rarity in the same treatment.

Slot: 1 Traditional foil Ring uncommon
description bullet: traditional foil uncommon with the showcase Ring treatment (23.3%), a borderless scene common (41.8%) or uncommon (32.6%), or a Nazgûl uncommon (2.3%) – Here, you can open one of the listed cards in traditional foil (which can include the common and uncommon borderless scene cards found in Prerelease Packs and Bundles).

Slot: 1 Traditional foil Booster Fun Common or Uncommon
description bullet: 1 Traditional foil uncommon with the showcase Ring treatment (23.3%), a borderless scene common (41.8%) or uncommon (32.6%), or a Nazgûl uncommon (2.3%)

Slot: 1 Traditional foil Rare or Mythic Rare Booster Fun
description bullet:
In the final slot of The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth Collector Boosters, you can find 1 of 30 Realms and Relics mythic rares in surge foil (0.8%). This surge foiling is a striking foil treatment and matches the treatment used in our Warhammer 40,000 Commander decks.
Everything else found in this slot will be in our traditional foil treatment. This includes the 14 rares (24.8%) and 6 mythic rares (5.0%) with the showcase Ring treatment; the 5 rare borderless lands (9.9%) and 1 mythic rare borderless land (1.2%); the 21 rare (39.7%) and 9 mythic rare borderless scene cards (8.7%); and the 8 new-to-Magic mythic rare Commander cards in extended art (9.9%).
Once again, there are select rares and mythic rares that show up in multiple versions within this slot in traditional foil. You can find those cards in each variant half as often as other cards of equivalent rarity. In this way, you can get these cards as often, in total, as you can get cards that are only available in a single treatment.

Slot: 1 Surge foil full-art Middle-earth map land
description bullet: Inspired by popular maps depicting geography from The Lord of the Rings story, this treatment is found on 10 total basic lands (two of each kind). Each Special Edition Collector Booster is guaranteed to have 1 of the 10 in surge foil.

Slot: 1 Non-foil borderless Scene Box rare or mythic rare, or 1 extended-art rare Jumpstart card
description bullet: This slot is the place to find the 20 new borderless Scene Box rares (74%), the 4 new borderless Scene Box mythic rares (7%), or the 5 new extended-art Jumpstart rares (19%). Every card in this slot is brand new as of the holiday release, and this slot is the only place to find these treatments. Further down in this article, you can read about both The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth Jumpstart Volume 2 and the new Scene Box cards and products.

Slot: 1 Surge foil extended-art rare or mythic rare
description bullet: For fans of surge foil, this slot has some very exciting cards within! We gave 28 extended-art rares (86%) and 9 extended-art mythic rares (14%) the surge foil treatment. These 37 cards include all the extended-art versions from the main set of The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth summer release. They are the same 37 cards that you can find in non-foil in the summer Collector Booster and include cards such as The One Ring, Palantír of Orthanc, and Delighted Halfling.

Slot: 1 Surge foil Booster Fun card, or a surge foil or serialized Realms and Relics card
description bullet:
Serialized Realms and Relics cards are the scarcest find in this slot. We took the 30 Realms and Relics cards that were Box Toppers released earlier this year, gave them the double rainbow foil treatment, and serialize numbered each out of 100 (XXX/100). Appearing in just under 0.2% of Special Edition Collector Boosters, 1 of the 100 of each Realms and Relics card can be found here, like Ancient Tomb (Balin's Tomb) and The Great Henge (The Party Tree).
The remainder of the cards found in this slot all feature a surge foil treatment. In addition to serialized cards, the 30 Realms and Relics cards (12.6%) can be found in this slot with the surge foil treatment.
For surge foil showcase Ring cards, we took the 10 uncommons (50%), 14 rares (11.7%), and 6 mythic rares (2.5%) that can be found in the summer release and gave them the surge foil treatment. You can also find the 5 rare (4.2%) and 1 mythic rare (0.4%) borderless lands in surge foil.
We took the new borderless Scene Box cards, shown and discussed below, used them to create all-new borderless scene cards, 20 rares (16.7%) and 4 mythic rares (1.7%), and gave them the surge foil treatment. These Scene Box cards are available in traditional foil in the Scene Boxes themselves. In Special Edition Collector Boosters, they can be found in this slot in surge foil and in non-foil in a non-foil slot, as listed above.

Slot: 1 Silver foil or non-foil Brothers Hildebrandt card, 1 traditional foil or non-foil borderless poster card, or 1 serialized borderless poster card
description bullet:
For each of the 20 mythic rares featured in the summer's main set release, we created brand-new artwork with the borderless poster treatment. The first way you can find these awesome new renditions is as a serialized offering with the double rainbow foil treatment. There are 100 each of the serialized borderless poster cards (0.1%) numbered XXX/100.
Like their main set versions, the borderless poster cards are mythic rares. They are found in this slot in non-foil (11.1%) and traditional foil (11.1%) in addition to the serialized version.
This slot also features the art of the Brothers Hildebrandt extensively in both silver foil and non-foil. These are classic Magic cards that weren't in the original Tales of Middle-earth release but that we have now brought into the world of Middle-earth. There are 5 uncommon borderless Brothers Hildebrandt cards in non-foil (25%) and silver foil (25%). There are 10 rares in non-foil (11.1%) and silver foil (11.1%), and there are 5 mythic rares in non-foil (2.8%) and silver foil (2.7%).
Of note, this slot and the previous one are connected. If you get an uncommon from this slot, then you will have gotten a rare or mythic rare from the previous slot, and vice versa.
